messages:
Ravi Patel: Quick thread for LumenGrid case study + webinar. Need to lock recording + legal checks.
Dana Lowe: Recording slot request: May 5 9am PT (45m). Can we confirm by EOD?
Maya Singh: I'll prep the one-pager and draft quote. Legal usually wants numbers redacted unless we have explicit sign-off. @Legal-Bot any special flags?
Legal-Bot: Please submit draft: lumengrid-case-draft_v1.pdf. Flagged items: revenue %, customer logo usage rights. Ticket LR-810 opened. ETA 72 hours.
Leo Park: Webinar format idea: 8-min demo, 20-min customer story (interview), 12-min audience Q&A. Moderator: Maya or Leo. Thoughts?
Ravi Patel: Love it. Also propose a short benchmark appendix (single slide) showing latency improvements vs our standard baseline (Q1 2026). Need customer OK on the chart source.
Maya Singh: Draft quote suggestion: "LumenGrid cut inference costs and improved latency for production workflows, enabling faster iteration." Keep it non-numeric.
Jordan Hayes (LumenGrid): (external) We're OK with non-numeric phrasing. Can you share the draft and the chart? We'll ask our PMs to confirm.
Dana Lowe: Uploading draft to Drive now: /Marketing/CaseStudies/LumenGrid/draft. Include chart PNG: latency-chart-q1-2026.png
Ravi Patel: Embargo and publish cadence: publish post 2026-05-12, webinar 2026-05-14. Marketing calendar will hold those dates pending legal and customer sign-off.
Maya Singh: Lead routing: form should capture interest_type=pilot|purchase and route purchase/pilot to SDR_hot, others to nurture. Also add UTM params: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=lumengrid-case-2026.
Leo Park: Ops notes for recording: record separate audio, ask customer for a 300x300 PNG logo and a 2-sentence bio. Send calendar invite with Zoom link, record transcript.
Jordan Hayes (LumenGrid): We'll provide logo + headshot by Tue. Also can confirm a short success metric for internal use, but prefer we keep public quote qualitative.
Maya Singh: Copy sign-off flow: marketing reviews -> legal approves -> customer PM final OK. I'll own marketing review.
Ravi Patel: Production needs: edit turnaround 48 hours, two social cutdowns (30s, 90s), blog post (800-1000 words), one-pager for sales with appendix.
Dana Lowe: Noted. I'll create Asana tasks and tag production + design.
Legal-Bot: LR-810 status: draft received, reviewer assigned. Please avoid specific revenue or customer lists in public assets until LR closed.
Leo Park: Sales enablement: I'll draft benchmark appendix PDF and upload to /Sales/Enablement/LumenGrid once assets are final.
Maya Singh: On the day of recording, ask Jordan to join 15 minutes early for mics, and request a clean screenshot of their dashboard if available for visuals.
Jordan Hayes (LumenGrid): Will do. Thanks for the checklist.
Ops-Bot: Reminder: reserve webinar-prod cluster for 2026-05-14 30m starting 15 minutes before event.
Ravi Patel: Great progress. I'll follow up with a timeline, and ping legal if LR-810 needs escalation. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
